item.title: Report: CIA tortured more people with waterboarding than US agency admitted
item.description: A New York Times report lends credence to long-held belief that torture method was more widely used than acknowledged.

item.title: Egypt detains driver over Cairo fuel tanker fire that killed 31
item.description: Prosecutors order drug tests for the 21-year-old suspect, who says he was overtaking when the crash happened.

item.title: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police over low wages
item.description: Bangladeshi garment workers clashed with police after a 36% minimum wage increase fell short of their demands.

item.title: Attack on Saudi’s Jazan refinery kills one person, disrupts operations
item.description: The attack killed a Nepali national, injured several people and sparked a fire, Saudi Energy Ministry says.

item.title: Indian politician facing murder charges hosts 400,000-guest wedding
item.description: An estimated 400,000 people attended politician Anant Singh’s daughter’s lavish wedding in Bihar, India’s poorest state.

item.title: Mexico seeks US talks about suspected SpaceX debris
item.description: Mexico concerned as SpaceX ramps up rocket launches from Starbase near border in Texas.

item.title: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares for every US child
item.description: US children would receive one share from SpaceX and one from him personally, Musk said.

item.title: Peru burns more than 10 tonnes of seized drugs
item.description: Peru began burning 10.7 tonnes of seized narcotics in its seventh and final drug disposal operation of 2026

item.title: Why are winter rains forcing Palestinians in Gaza to flee again?
item.description: Israeli restrictions on humanitarian aid, damaged buildings and flooded tents leave displaced Palestinians vulnerable.

item.title: Judge strikes down Trump’s latest restrictions on US birthright citizenship
item.description: After a Supreme Court ruling against it, the Trump administration had tried a narrower set of restrictions.

item.title: Psychiatric care under scrutiny after abuse scandals in Croatia and Bosnia
item.description: Persistent failures in psychiatric care have been exposed, including staff shortages, poor training and weak oversight.

item.title: What will Trump’s latest tariffs mean for the world?
item.description: New measures come after previous trade tariffs ruled illegal.

item.title: Kushner explains the ‘good thing’ about Gaza’s destruction
item.description: Jared Kushner says the “good thing” about Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza is that it can be built into “something new”.

item.title: Trump calls GDP data released before midterms ‘fake’, demands investigation
item.description: President says it was a deliberate decision to release 'fake' growth numbers before US midterm elections.

item.title: Guinea-Bissau military leaders delay presidential election until 2028
item.description: Military leaders say presidential and legislative poll scheduled for December 6 will now take place in November 2028.

item.title: EU leaders struggle to agree on long-term budget, $49bn Ukraine loan
item.description: The bloc is holding an extraordinary summit in Brussels to discuss its budget proposal for 2028 to 2034.

item.title: Netanyahu’s corruption trial: Is it really all over?
item.description: Court recommendations put the Israeli leader's trial, political future and efforts to evade prosecution back in focus.

item.title: Syrian children continue learning amid the ruins of war in Idlib
item.description: Syria reopened a semi destroyed school in Idlib province

item.title: French actor Gerard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged 2018 rape
item.description: Paris court of appeal dismisses allegations relating to a second incident involving actress Charlotte Arnould.

item.title: How a teen’s death raises questions about Colombia’s security crackdown
item.description: President Abelardo de la Espriella's campaign against armed groups has resulted in accusations of extrajudicial killing.

item.title: Two Italians killed by ‘drone strike debris’ in Kuwait
item.description: Iran has strongly denied any involvement in the fatal incident.

item.title: Spanish economist to become new European Central Bank chief
item.description: Economist Pablo Hernandez de Cos was announced after a meeting of eurozone leaders.

item.title: Why is France roiling?
item.description: Al Jazeera’s Ramy Allahoum looks at how France's financial crisis is shaping next year’s vote.

item.title: Diesel tanker capsizes near Ibiza, killing crew member
item.description: Aerial footage shows the capsized Maltese-flagged Med Emre chemical tanker off the Spanish island of Ibiza.

item.title: Two dead after Iranian drone attack on Kuwait
item.description: Kuwait’s army says two Italian workers were killed and four others were injured in an Iranian drone attack.
